msg: Hi, we're two Dutch divers, both Rescue Divers, in Cartagena from the 10th to the 16th. We bring our own full gear. We want to dive on three separate days from Cartagena, coming back to the city each night. What's the best price for us?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! From Cartagena, the available certified-diving option for a day trip is *2 dives per day*, with a return to the city the same day. For three separate days, you’d book that day trip for each day.

Bringing your complete gear qualifies for a *5% own-equipment discount* on recreational diving; it can be combined with the online discount. The exact total for all three days will be shown at checkout.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 5 Dives - 2 days: 392 USD · 436 USD
• 7 Dives - 3 days: 503 USD · 558 USD

I’m leaving the prices below. Would you like the booking link for the 2-dive day trip?

msg: Yes please, the 2-dive day trip on the 11th, 13th and 15th. How do we apply the own-equipment discount in the booking?
reply:
The 5% own-equipment discount applies because you’re bringing your complete gear. It can be combined with the 10% online discount, which is applied automatically when you book on our website. There’s no discount code; the own-equipment discount needs to be applied by the team, so please request it before paying. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor?

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day)*
💰 *178 USD* per person (online rate) · 2 people
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

⚠️ If anyone hasn't dived for *more than 2 years*, a *refresher* is added (the mini-course: pool and one dive with an instructor): *183 USD* per person.

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Is that your case?
